effect_description_eng:
While you don't have [Rook Device] in the battle area, you may ignore this card's color requirements.
When effects trash this card from the battle area, until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.), ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) and gets +2000 DP.
[Main] Until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.), ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) and gets +2000 DP. Then, place this card in the battle area.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] ＜De-Digivolve 2＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash up to 2 cards from the top. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) Then, add this card to the hand.
